submission.justification: Recommend Absorber-F1 with 5.4 mm plates. Absorber-F1 consistently gives the best 100 GeV electron energy resolution among the three candidate absorbers: the 2025 reference simulation at 5 mm gave F1/F2/F3 = 3.2%/3.9%/5.1%, and the new Geant4 scan again found F1 well ahead of F2 and F3. A thickness scan for F1 showed a broad optimum near 5--6 mm; repeated 100k-event simulations at 5.4 mm gave an average resolution of about 3.18%, slightly better than nearby checked settings such as 5.25 mm (~3.19%), 6.0 mm (~3.20%), 5.9 mm (~3.24%), and 5.5 mm (~3.24%). The chosen 5.4 mm thickness is inside the allowed 2--10 mm range and avoids the degradation observed for very thin or very thick plates. Project documents state all candidate absorbers are machinable to tolerance, mechanically compatible with the support, and use the common readout/cooling designs; no absorber-specific maintenance incompatibility is identified.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: New 100k-event Geant4 scans showed Absorber-F1 outperforms F2 and F3 over the tested range. Around the optimum, repeated F1 simulations averaged ~3.18% at 5.4 mm, compared with ~3.19% at 5.25 mm, ~3.20% at 6.0 mm, ~3.24% at 5.9 mm, and ~3.24% at 5.5 mm; coarse scans of F2 and F3 were much worse, with best checked values ~3.89% and ~5.18%, respectively.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Absorber-F1, Absorber-F2, and Absorber-F3; the recommendation selects Absorber-F1.

requirements.requirement: The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.
requirements.evidence: Meeting notes state the mechanical support is compatible with every candidate absorber; cooling.md says the heat load is dominated by front-end electronics; readout.md says the silicon-pad readout and ASIC are common to all absorber options. No project document identifies Absorber-F1 as requiring remote handling or as incompatible with shutdown access.
The recommended plate thickness is 5.4 mm, which lies within the allowed 2--10 mm interval.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted a single recommendation: Absorber-F1 with 5.4 mm plates.
